summary: Language-semantics review of redacting_filter.py and html_to_text.py: five findings, worst being partial credential redaction with a leaked tail and a dict-args rebuild that makes logging drop records; plus dead exc_text guard leaving tracebacks unredacted and a double-unescape in html_to_text.
notes: LANGUAGE-SEMANTICS REVIEW (scoped to the two files named in the brief; five findings, by consequence). 1. api_key/zsessionid partial redaction — credential tail leaks. /workspace/src/rally_tui/utils/redacting_filter.py:36 and :41. [\w\-_]+ excludes '.', '+', '/', '=' (base64/JWT chars); the match stops at the first excluded char and sub() replaces only the prefix: 'apikey=_abc.Def+ghi=' -> 'apikey=[REDACTED].Def+ghi='. Partially-redacted credential is worse than no match because the log looks sanitized. The bearer (line 46) and token (line 100) patterns in the same list already include '.'; widen to e.g. [^\s"']+. 2. url_creds over-greedy. /workspace/src/rally_tui/utils/redacting_filter.py:106, re.compile(r'://[^:]+:[^@]+@'). Negated classes match whitespace and newlines, so [^@]+@ can span lines and eat unrelated text (over-redaction), and 'https://user:p@ss@host' matches '://user:p@' leaving 'ss@host' logged (tail leak). 3. filter() breaks mapping-style log calls — record dropped at emit. /workspace/src/rally_tui/utils/redacting_filter.py:139-143. logging permits logger.info('%(k)s', {'k': 'v'}) with record.args a dict; iterating a dict yields keys, so record.args becomes ('k',), and emit-time getMessage() does '%(k)s' % ('k',) -> TypeError 'format requires a mapping' -> 'Logging error' to stderr, record lost. Preserve dicts or skip non-tuple args. 4. exc_info never redacted; exc_text guard effectively dead; non-str args bypass. /workspace/src/rally_tui/utils/redacting_filter.py:145-146 and :141. exc_text is set by Formatter.format() at emit time and is None at filter time on the first handler, so the guard normally does nothing and logger.exception()/exc_info tracebacks go out untouched — this app's exception messages embed Rally queries carrying DisplayName/Project.Name. And line 141 redacts only args already isinstance str: logger.error('failed: %s', exc) passes the exception object through, stringified (with any secret in it) at emit time. Pre-format redaction is the wrong layer; redact formatted output instead. 5. html_to_text double-decodes entities; strip-then-unescape order resurrects escaped tags. /workspace/src/rally_tui/utils/html_to_text.py:104-116. The parser's default convert_charrefs=True already decodes references in data; the trailing html.unescape (line 116) decodes a second time: '<b>' -> '<b>' -> literal ''. The except-Exception fallback (line 111) first strips tags with re.sub (line 113) and then unescapes, so '<script>' becomes a literal
